endpoints.description: BK-41. Any signed-in user; idempotent. If another account registers the same token it moves to them; tokens Expo reports as DeviceNotRegistered are deleted. 400 invalid_token if it isn't an Expo token. DELETE /me/push-tokens/{token} (204) on logout. App: utils/pushNotifications registers after login (Android channel, permission, getExpoPushTokenAsync — needs expo.extra.eas.projectId from `eas init`) and unregisters on logout / account deletion; components/NotificationTapRouter opens the screen for data.type.

Everything always lands in the in-app inbox; these choose the extra channels per category. categories only lists what applies to this person (business once they own or work at a business, payouts for owners and staff). availableChannels: push is the server switch (NOTIFY_PUSH_ENABLED), sms needs a phone on the account, email an email. reminders is the original C5 block (kept for older apps); reminders.sms/push are the same values as categories.reminders.sms/push.
Only the fields sent change; returns the full preferences. categories.<category>.<push|sms|email>; reminders.dayBefore / twoHoursBefore pick which reminders go out. Unknown categories are ignored.

endpoints.screen: Notifications (bell in every mode's first tab)
endpoints.description: The signed-in user's in-app inbox across every role they hold (customer, owner, staff, front desk), newest first. Every push is also written here with the same type/data (see register-push-token's pushTypes), so a row opens the same screen as its push. unread=true narrows to unread rows; unreadCount always counts every unread row so one call can refresh the bell. Cursor-paginated: pass nextCursor back, null on the last page. Rows older than 90 days can be dropped. App: api/notifications.ts (USE_MOCK_NOTIFICATIONS until this ships), store/useNotificationsStore, screens/account/NotificationsScreen.

endpoints.auth: any signed-in user (Bearer header; send Last-Event-ID when reconnecting)
endpoints.description: Server-sent events (text/event-stream). Events: ready {heartbeatSeconds}; notification (same shape as list-notifications items, id: = notificationId); resync (events may have been missed: refetch the inbox and what's on screen); reconnect (server is rotating the stream, about every 25 min: reconnect now). A ': ping' comment every heartbeatSeconds. With Last-Event-ID the server replays up to 50 missed notifications, else sends resync. 401 invalid/expired token (refresh and reconnect), 429 too_many_streams (max 5 per account). App: open only while in the foreground; exponential backoff with jitter; reconnect if nothing arrives for 3 heartbeats.

endpoints.description: Set the profile picture: multipart field photo (JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB). The server fixes rotation, crops it square and stores one 512px JPEG (tens of KB) under a new URL each time; the old file is deleted. The picture also becomes their staff photo at every business they work at. Returns the User (avatar_url set).

Use the picture on their Google account (has_google_picture is true once they've signed in with Google). Fetched at 512px and stored like an upload. New Google sign-ups get it automatically in the background.

errors.when: never signed in with Google, or Google has no picture
